MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Eagles collections fit my interest in familiar classic rock, reflected in The Cars and Now Classic Rock Hits.",
    "Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons connects directly with the melodic sixties pop I sought in AM Gold and my other best-of collections.",
    "25 appeals through melodic pop and expressive singing, which also drew me to Born This Way and Cheek to Cheek."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The country albums do not connect strongly enough with the familiar older pop and rock songs I want today; being tuneful or song-focused is not enough for me to choose them.",
    "Keith Urban's hits collection has an appealing format, but that does not establish an interest in the artist.",
    "Duets could connect with Cheek to Cheek, but without knowing the performer I cannot judge whether the voices and songs would appeal to me."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in greatest-hits collections seems to have been extended to artists I have not shown much interest in.",
    "My occasional interest in newer pop seems to have been stretched into a broader appetite for contemporary albums than I feel right now."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The repeated appeal of familiar sixties pop and classic rock matters more to me today than a general connection between singers or albums.",
    "Both Eagles collections suit my taste, but I would choose only one because they serve the same listening interest this time.",
    "My interest in a duet album depends on the particular performers, rather than the duet format alone."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my taste for familiar melodic pop and classic rock, but extended it too broadly to country albums and unfamiliar artists."
}
